request.title: NIGHTMARE KING GRIMM
request.creativeDirection: Cinematic Hollow Knight boss portrait edit. Deep crimson, black shadows, glowing embers, dramatic close-ups, no gameplay HUD, no menus, no player character, no commentary, no AI voice.

research.subject: Nightmare King Grimm from Hollow Knight: The Grimm Troupe
visualRules: Only use the exact Nightmare King Grimm or his recognisable boss arena shown in each named source.
No HUD, health bars, geo counter, menus, player character, other bosses, unrelated characters, or fan art.
Use cinematic centre-focused crops; keep Grimm visible.

storytelling.structure: ominous reveal, character reveal, escalating attacks, final portrait
storytelling.pacing: deliberate opening followed by faster dramatic cuts and a final held shot

visuals.depicts: Nightmare King Grimm hovering in the crimson-lit nightmare arena beside a towering flame
